phases.objective: Convert failed push-time Work Map currentness on exact main from a recurring manual repair into a fail-closed, SHA-bound post-merge convergence loop that consumes the existing Integration Gate repair evidence and delegates all Work Map generation and repository mutation to the sole registered generated-artifact writer on a non-protected branch.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec Kit Work Map Integration, read-only main convergence dispatcher, and governed generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Spec Kit Work Map Integration completes with failure for a push event whose head branch and live exact head are main, after publishing its bounded exact-head Work Map repair candidate artifact.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher validates the immutable failed Integration run and its exact-head repair evidence without generating or writing Work Maps, then delegates the exact main SHA to work_map_self_hosting_bootstrap on chore/work-map-main-sync-<sha12>; the writer creates or validates that branch, performs the deterministic Work Map convergence, pushes without force, reads back the exact result head, and dispatches read-only verification while main and Production remain untouched.
steps: Accept only a failed Spec Kit Work Map Integration workflow_run whose source event is push, source branch is main, and source SHA still equals the live main ref; manual recovery requires the exact same main SHA plus REQUEST_WORK_MAP_MAIN_CONVERGENCE and resolves an existing failed push run for that SHA.
Re-read the source workflow run and require the canonical workflow path, push event, main branch, exact source SHA, completed state, failure conclusion, and valid run attempt.
Resolve exactly the non-expired work-map-repair-candidate-main-<full-sha> artifact from that failed run and download it without checking out or executing repository code.

Validate mad4b.work-map-repair-candidate.v1 identity: repository, run ID, run attempt, event and tested SHA, exact-checkout flag, docs/work-maps allowed root, no remote write, no secrets, and a valid source SHA-256.

Require report changed_count and changed_files to match the artifact changed-files manifest exactly, reject duplicates or paths outside docs/work-maps, reject symlinks, and require every declared changed output to exist in the artifact.
Derive one SHA-specific target branch chore/work-map-main-sync-<sha12> and re-read live main before any delegation.

If the target branch is absent or still equals the exact source main SHA, dispatch the governed generated-artifact writer; if an already-converged generated-only descendant exists, stop idempotently; reject unrelated branch collisions or generated-scope escape.
Invoke only work_map_self_hosting_bootstrap with create_from_main=true, source_main_sha equal to expected_head_sha, and the typed generated-artifact confirmation.

Inside the writer, reject main and Production targets, validate the Work Map convergence branch namespace, require exact live-main equality, create the target branch only from that exact main SHA, and never force-push.

Inside the sole writer tool, run the existing Work Map bootstrap convergence twice, require identical bounded binary diffs, run currentness and binding verification, and reject any generated write-set escape.

Commit only registered generated artifacts after exact-head CAS, push without force, require post-push remote readback, and dispatch read-only PR Generated Artifact Refresh verification on the resulting exact branch head; PR publication and merge remain separate governed actions.
assertions: A failed Work Map Integration run from a stale main SHA cannot start a repair.
A non-push event, non-main branch, successful source run, malformed SHA, mismatched workflow path, or missing exact repair artifact cannot start automatic main convergence.
The classifier/delegator has contents read only and performs no Work Map generator execution, git commit, git push, direct protected-ref update, force push, or PR merge.
The dispatcher consumes the Integration Gate's existing exact-head repair evidence instead of becoming a second Work Map producer.
Repair evidence must be bound to the exact failed run and run attempt, exact main SHA, repository, allowed root, changed-file manifest, no-remote-write declaration, and no-secret declaration.
The target branch identity is derived from the exact source main SHA, making retries idempotent and preventing cross-main branch reuse.
Existing target reuse is accepted only for the exact source seed or an already-converged generated-only descendant; unrelated branch contents or write-set escape fail closed.

create_from_main is accepted for work_map_self_hosting_bootstrap only under the SHA-specific Work Map convergence branch pattern or for the pre-existing Repository Inventory convergence recipe under its own pattern.
Deterministic double-pass Work Map generation remains inside the sole registered generated-artifact writer tool, not in the dispatcher.
The generated-artifact writer still rejects main and Production as mutation targets and preserves exact-head CAS, bounded changed paths, post-push readback, and no-force-push semantics.
The ordinary Spec Kit Work Map Integration gate remains read-only and continues to publish an exact-head repair candidate before failing closed on stale generated Work Maps.
No Production deployment, database or provider mutation, credential payload read, migration apply, grant mutation, or protected-branch mutation is part of this feature.

phases.objective: Observe the first exact-main failed Work Map currentness run after this authority is trusted on main and verify exact repair-artifact validation, automatic SHA-specific branch creation, governed deterministic regeneration, read-only exact-head verification, and idempotent retry behavior.
blockers: The dispatcher and create_from_main Work Map authority are not trusted until this source change merges to main; the first post-merge canary must remain non-protected and review-gated.

phases.objective: Exercise stale workflow_run heads, main movement during evidence validation, missing or expired artifact, mismatched run attempt, forged repair identity, artifact symlink, changed-file manifest mismatch, generated-path escape, pre-existing unrelated target collisions, seeded-target retry, already-converged target retry, writer nondeterminism, writer CAS failure, and verifier-dispatch failure.
Use the first real post-merge Work Map drift as a bounded canary with exact main identity, exact failed-run repair evidence, and no protected-ref mutation.
Keep Production entirely outside this repository-generated-state convergence path.
